messages:
jordan: quick heads-up — noticed /v1/compute examples in the api ref still show \"inputs\": null. runtime treats that as missing KV and our python/js SDKs error when they try to iterate. this is causing one-off user breakage.

maria: ah thank you for spotting. where exactly? openapi examples or the generated SDK snippets?

jordan: both — the OpenAPI example body has \"inputs\": null, and the curl/python snippets copy that example. minimal repro: curl -X POST /v1/compute -d '{\"model\":\"x\",\"inputs\":null}' returns 400 in our infra test.

kevin: I can take the examples on this one. plan: replace null with an empty array `[]` and add a short note in the param description: \"prefer empty-array or omit; null currently unsupported by SDKs\".

maria: sgtm. do we want a migration note in the top-level generate/chat/completions migration doc too? some customers might have posted nulls.

jordan: yes please add a one-liner in the migration guide and a changelog entry. put the clarifying sentence under the request body schema too — \"inputs: array[string] — nullable: false\" and example shows `[]`.

kevin: making the PR now. editing both OpenAPI example + docs snippets: python/js/rust. will also run unit check that examples parse into the SDK request objects.

maria: thanks — ping me when it's up. also can we add a short test that the examples round-trip into the OpenAPI validator? we've had regressions when snippets drift.

kevin: yes adding `tools/docs/validate_examples.sh` call in the docs CI job. snippet in PR.

jordan: linking a quick example in case useful: ```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-alpha\",
  \"inputs\": []
}
```

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — updated examples, added migration note, bumped example tests.

maria: :eyes: reviewing now. can you also update the inline SDK snippet that constructs the request in the JS guide? it currently does `const r = { model, inputs: null }` in the example.

kevin: good catch — fixed to `inputs: []` and added comment `// avoid null` in the snippet.

docs-bot: docs-ci succeeded for PR 4123 (:white_check_mark:) — link: https://ci.internal.redwood/4123

maria: looks good to me. approving. jordan, any additional wording you want in the param desc?

jordan: add: \"If your upstream code may produce null, sanitize to [] to avoid deserialization errors.\" otherwise ship.

kevin: merged and will cut a minor docs deploy after low-traffic window. will backfill changelog entry.

maria: nice — thanks everyone.

jordan: thanks Kevin, appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
